glosses.notes: Used for old buildings, ruins, and other places preserved because they carry historical value.

examples.sentence: 这处古迹原来在山里很安静，后来游客越来越多以后，村里才决定每天安排人站在门口提醒大家别乱写字。
城里那片古迹修了半年才重新开放，可是进去以后不能随便摸墙，也不能把水带进去。
导游说如果只在门口拍照就走，很难看出这处古迹以前怎么住人，所以最好慢一点跟着导游往里看。

example_translations.translation: This historic site used to be quiet in the mountains, but after more and more tourists began coming, the village decided to station someone at the entrance every day to remind people not to scribble around.
That historic area was repaired for half a year before reopening, but once you go inside, you cannot touch the walls freely or take water farther in.
The guide said that if you only take a photo at the entrance and leave, it is hard to see how people once lived at this historic site, so it is better to go in slowly with the guide.

glosses.notes: A stock is a share of ownership in a company, and the word often comes up when talking about buying, selling, and investment risk.

examples.sentence: 父亲以前从来不碰股票，可是这两年听朋友讲得太多，还是先拿手里一点钱试着买了最熟悉的那家公司。
她看见那只股票一天里涨得太快，反而没有马上买进，因为总觉得自己还没把风险想明白。
新闻一出来，那家公司的股票就一直往下掉，连原来最有耐心的老客户也开始想后面怎么办。

example_translations.translation: Father had never touched stocks before, but after hearing friends talk about them so much these past two years, he still tried buying a little of the company he knew best with some money he had on hand.
When she saw that stock shoot up too fast in a single day, she did not buy in right away, because she still felt she had not thought through the risk.
As soon as the news came out, that company's stock kept falling, and even the older clients who were usually the most patient started wondering what they should do next.

glosses.notes: 古人 means people of earlier times, especially people in ancient China as they appear in history, writing, and traditional culture.

examples.sentence: 老师讲到古人怎么看天气的时候，没有先讲大道理，而是先让我们看他们怎么根据风和云安排第二天出门。
这本书把古人写信时最在意的礼貌都讲得很细，所以连平时不爱看旧书信的人也能慢慢看进去。
母亲去看展览以后才发现，古人做饭用的很多东西虽然简单，可是摆在今天看也一点都不随便。

example_translations.translation: When the teacher explained how people in ancient times looked at the weather, she did not start with big theories. She first showed us how they used the wind and clouds to plan going out the next day.
This book explains in great detail the manners the ancients cared about when writing letters, so even people who do not usually like old correspondence can slowly get into it.
After going to the exhibit, Mother realized that although many things people in ancient times used for cooking were simple, they still did not look careless at all today.

glosses.notes: 股市 means the stock market as a whole, especially the broader ups and downs that affect prices, plans, and investor mood.

examples.sentence: 最近股市一有消息就大起大落，所以经理开会时先提醒大家，别因为一天的变化就把长期计划全改了。
他原来以为股市离普通人的生活很远，后来看到父亲的退休钱也会受影响，才开始认真看每天的报道。
电视里一说股市又跌了，店里几个常来说话的老人马上都走到电视前，连本来要回家的几个人也先站住不走了。

example_translations.translation: Lately, the stock market has been swinging sharply whenever any news appears, so at the meeting the manager reminded everyone not to rewrite the long-term plan because of a single day's change.

He used to think the stock market was far removed from ordinary people's lives, but later, when he saw that even his father's retirement money could be affected, he started seriously following the daily reports.

The moment television said the stock market had fallen again, several older people who often came to sit and talk in the shop walked over to the television, and even the ones who had been about to go home stopped and stayed.

glosses.notes: Usually means bones in the body or bone pieces in food, depending on the scene.

examples.sentence: 医生看完片子以后说，虽然骨头没有断，可是周围还是伤得不轻，这几天最好先别急着自己上下楼。
这锅汤要煮很久，是因为母亲想让骨头里的味道慢慢出来，这样刚出院的人喝的时候更容易一点。
孩子吃骨头的时候太着急，外公赶紧让他先停下来，说里面那几小块如果卡住了，晚上就更难睡。

example_translations.translation: After looking at the scan, the doctor said that although the bone was not broken, the surrounding area was still hurt quite badly, so for the next few days it would be best not to rush into going up and down the stairs alone.
This pot of soup has to be cooked for a long time because Mother wants the flavor in the bones to come out slowly, which makes it a little easier for someone fresh out of the hospital to drink.
The child was eating the bones too hastily, and Grandpa quickly told him to stop first, saying that if one of those small pieces got stuck, it would be even harder to sleep at night.

glosses.notes: As a verb, 鼓舞 means to encourage or inspire; it can also describe something as emotionally uplifting.

examples.sentence: 队里连着输了两场以后，教练没有先批评谁，而是拿出大家上个月最好的录像，想重新鼓舞一下快没信心的人。
她看见病房里的老人听完那句话以后明显笑了，才知道有时候一句很普通的安慰也能把人鼓舞起来。
这部电影最鼓舞人的地方，不是最后谁赢了，而是那些快坚持不住的人一直没有先放弃彼此。

example_translations.translation: After the team lost two matches in a row, the coach did not criticize anyone first. Instead, he brought out the group's best recording from last month, hoping to inspire the people who were close to losing confidence.
When she saw the older patient in the hospital room smile after hearing that sentence, she realized that even a very ordinary bit of comfort can lift a person's spirits.
What feels most inspiring about this film is not who wins in the end, but the fact that the people who were close to giving up still did not let go of one another first.

glosses.notes: In compact or written-style Chinese, 顾 means to look after, attend to, or keep something in mind while handling something else.

examples.sentence: 她白天在店里顾生意，晚上回家以后还得顾老人吃药，所以常常刚坐下没多久又站起来了。
经理安排周末值班的时候，不但要看人最多的时段，还得顾几个年轻同事回老家的车票时间。
父亲住院那几天，母亲一边顾家里的孩子，一边往医院跑，连吃饭都常常是走到楼下才想起来。

example_translations.translation: She looks after the business during the day, and after going home at night she still has to make sure the older person takes medicine, so she often gets back up not long after sitting down.
When the manager arranges weekend duty, he has to think not only about the busiest time slots, but also about when several younger coworkers have train tickets home.

During the days Father was in the hospital, Mother was looking after the children at home while also running back and forth to the hospital, and she often did not even remember eating until she had already walked downstairs.

glosses.notes: 固体 means solid matter and is used when talking about physical states like solid, liquid, and gas.

examples.sentence: 老师做实验的时候先把那块固体放进水里，让大家看它虽然慢慢变小，可是一下子还不会像糖那样全化开。
工厂的人解释说，这种东西常温下是固体，所以搬的时候只怕进水，不像前一种材料那样容易漏出来。
医生给孩子看图的时候说，药放进身体以后有的会先变成液体，有的本来就是固体，作用的时间也不一样。

example_translations.translation: During the experiment, the teacher first put that solid into water and let everyone see that although it slowly became smaller, it still would not dissolve all at once like sugar.
The factory workers explained that this substance is a solid at room temperature, so when moving it the only real worry is water getting in, unlike the previous material, which could leak out easily.

While showing the child a diagram, the doctor said that after medicine enters the body, some of it first becomes liquid, while some of it is already solid to begin with, so the timing of its effect is not the same.

glosses.notes: A 顾问 is an outside or senior advisor people consult for judgment, strategy, or expert advice.

examples.sentence: 公司请来的顾问没有先看漂亮的数据，而是先去门店站了两个小时，想知道客人到底在哪一步最容易离开。
校长把老顾问请回来，不是为了多一个签字的人，而是想听听他怎么看这几年学生变化得这么快。
她第一次跟顾问开会的时候很紧张，后来发现对方一直在帮她把乱的想法慢慢理顺，心里才安静一点。

example_translations.translation: The consultant invited by the company did not start by looking at the polished data. He first spent two hours standing in the shop, wanting to know at exactly which step customers were most likely to walk away.

The principal invited the old advisor back not because another person was needed for signatures, but because he wanted to hear how that advisor understood the way students had changed so quickly over these past years.
She was nervous the first time she met with the consultant, but later she realized he had been helping her slowly sort out her tangled ideas, and only then did she calm down a little.

glosses.notes: 故障 is a breakdown or malfunction in a machine, system, vehicle, or service that stops it from working normally.

examples.sentence: 地铁刚进站就因为故障停住了，很多人起初还以为只是晚了几分钟，后来才发现广播一直在重复同一句说明。
师傅检查了半天才找到故障在哪儿，原来不是机器太旧，而是昨天换上的那个小零件本身就有问题。
家里暖气一出故障，母亲先怕的不是冷，而是晚上老人如果睡不好，第二天吃药和出门都会受影响。

example_translations.translation: The subway had just entered the station when it stopped because of a breakdown. At first many people thought it was only a delay of a few minutes, but later they realized the announcement kept repeating the same message.

The repair worker spent a long time checking before finding where the malfunction was. It turned out the machine was not simply too old; the small part that had been replaced yesterday already had a problem.

As soon as the heat at home broke down, what Mother feared first was not the cold itself, but that if the older person did not sleep well that night, taking medicine and going out the next day would both be affected.

glosses.notes: 拐 can mean to turn in a direction, and it can also describe limping or walking unevenly after an injury.

examples.sentence: 前面的路口没有红灯，司机还是提前放慢了速度，因为再往前一拐就是学校，放学的时候孩子特别多。
他脚上那块伤口还没好透，走到楼下的时候还是一拐一拐的，所以同事都劝他今天别自己搬东西。
导游怕后面的车找不到路，就一直挥手提醒大家，过了桥先别急着加速，看到那棵老树再往左拐。

example_translations.translation: There was no traffic light at the intersection ahead, but the driver still slowed down early, because one more turn ahead was the school, and there were especially many children there when classes ended.
The wound on his foot had not fully healed yet, so by the time he walked downstairs he was still limping, and his coworkers all told him not to move things by himself today.
The guide was afraid the cars behind would lose the road, so he kept waving and reminding everyone not to speed up after crossing the bridge and to turn left only when they saw that old tree.

glosses.notes: 拐弯 means turning a corner or making a turn, either on foot or while driving.

examples.sentence: 这条小路白天看着不难走，可是一到晚上灯太少，很多第一次来的人刚拐弯就会把门口看错。
司机听见前面有人喊的时候已经来不及马上停住，只好在拐弯以前先大声提醒，对面的人别再往中间走。
搬家那天那辆大车在楼下拐弯时试了两次都没过去，最后还是门口卖菜的人出来帮着看位置。

example_translations.translation: This little path does not look hard to walk in daylight, but once night comes and there is too little light, many first-time visitors mistake the entrance as soon as they turn the corner.

By the time the driver heard someone shout ahead, it was already too late to stop at once, so before making the turn he had no choice but to call out loudly and remind the people opposite not to keep walking toward the middle.

On moving day, that large truck tried twice to get around the corner downstairs and still could not make it through, and in the end the person selling vegetables at the entrance had to come out and help guide the position.

glosses.notes: As a noun, 官 means an official or officeholder; in modern Chinese it most often appears in phrases like 做官 and 官员.

examples.sentence: 村里老人常说，做官的人如果只坐在家里听报告，就不知道那条旧桥一下雨为什么总让孩子不敢过。
古人写的故事里总有那种小官，职位不大，可是天天夹在上面和下面之间，连一句真话都不容易说。
他后来没有去做官，而是留在县里当老师，因为总觉得能把眼前这批孩子教好，比换个职位更实在。

example_translations.translation: The older people in the village often say that if an official only sits at home listening to reports, he will never know why that old bridge always scares children whenever it rains.
In stories about the past, there is always that kind of minor official: the position is not high, yet he is caught between above and below every day, and even saying one honest sentence is not easy.
In the end, he did not go become an official but stayed in the county to teach, because he felt that teaching the children in front of him well was more solid than changing to another position.

glosses.notes: 关爱 means giving warm, active care, often toward children, older people, patients, or other people who especially need attention.

examples.sentence: 社区这几年一直关爱一个人住的老人，不只是送东西，更重要的是常常上门看看他们最近到底缺什么。
老师发现那个孩子最近总一个人坐着，就开始特别关爱他，连放学以后也会顺路问问家里的情况。
广告拍得最打动人的，不是画面多好看，而是那位母亲一句很轻的话，让人一下子明白什么叫真正的关爱。

example_translations.translation: For the past few years, the community has been caring for older people who live by themselves. It is not just about delivering things; more importantly, people often go to their homes to see what they have really been lacking lately.
When the teacher noticed that the child had been sitting alone a lot lately, she began showing him special care and would even ask about things at home on the way after school.
What moved people most in the advertisement was not how beautiful the images were, but one soft sentence from the mother that instantly made people understand what real loving care means.

glosses.notes: 官方 refers to the official side of an institution or the formal message released in its name.

examples.sentence: 消息刚传开的时候，大家说法很多，后来还是等官方把完整说明放出来以后，家长们心里才安静一点。
记者去问的时候，对方没有先讲个人看法，只说官方以后会回答大家最关心的问题。
这条路封了三天以后，大家最想知道的不是原因多复杂，而是官方什么时候能把新路线贴出来。

example_translations.translation: When the news first spread, people had many different explanations, but only after the official side released the full statement did parents feel a little calmer.
When the reporter went to ask, the other side did not begin with a personal opinion and only said that the authorities would answer the questions everyone cared about most later on.
After the road had been closed for three days, what people most wanted to know was not how complicated the reason was, but when the authorities would post the new route.

glosses.notes: 观光 means sightseeing or going around a place mainly to look at its scenery and attractions.

examples.sentence: 这座小城最近来观光的人越来越多，所以很多老住户晚上出门的时候，都会先绕开最热闹的那几条街。
我们原来只打算在海边观光半天，可是后来听说山上的旧路刚修好，就又临时多留了一晚。
导游提醒大家，观光的时候如果一直只顾着拍照，回去以后反而想不起那家小店的味道和声音。

example_translations.translation: Lately more and more people have been coming to sightsee in this small city, so many longtime residents now go out of their way to avoid the busiest streets in the evening.
We had originally planned to sightsee by the sea for only half a day, but later, after hearing that the old road up the mountain had just been repaired, we ended up staying one extra night.
The guide reminded everyone that if you only focus on taking pictures while sightseeing, you may go back afterward and find that you cannot even remember the smell and sounds of that little shop.

glosses.notes: 关怀 is a warm, slightly formal word for showing care and concern for someone's condition or needs.

examples.sentence: 公司后来加了夜班以后，经理先关怀夜班同事晚上回家的安全，而不是一开口就催进度，所以人心稳定了很多。
医生虽然很忙，可是每次去病房看人的时候都会先关怀一下那个总睡不着的老人，问他昨天晚上有没有什么地方特别难受。
学校安排新老师去外地以前，专门开会谈怎么关怀刚毕业的年轻人，免得他们一开始就觉得很不习惯。

example_translations.translation: After the company added a night shift, the manager first showed care for the night-shift coworkers' safety on the way home instead of opening his mouth just to push progress, and that settled people down a lot.

Although the doctor was very busy, whenever he went to the ward to see people, he would first show concern for the older patient who could never sleep, asking whether any part of his body had felt especially uncomfortable the evening before.

Before sending new teachers away to work elsewhere, the school specifically held a meeting to discuss how to care for young people who had just graduated, so that they would not feel too unaccustomed right at the start.

glosses.notes: 关联 means being connected or related, especially when one thing affects, explains, or points to another.

examples.sentence: 表面上看，这两件投诉好像没有什么关联，可是把时间和地点放在一起以后，工作人员马上发现问题都出在同一台机器。
医生说这次头疼不一定只和睡得少有关联，还可能跟她最近一直空着肚子喝咖啡也有关系。
经理把几个数字来回看了很久，因为只要找到哪两个环节关联最紧，后面节省时间的办法就会清楚很多。

example_translations.translation: On the surface, these two complaints did not seem related, but once the time and place were put together, the staff immediately realized the problems had both come from the same machine.
The doctor said this headache might not be connected only to sleeping too little; it could also be related to the fact that she had been drinking coffee on an empty stomach lately.
The manager looked back and forth at several figures for a long time, because once he could find which two steps were most tightly connected, the way to save time afterward would become much clearer.

glosses.notes: 观赏 means to watch something carefully for its beauty or interest, not just to pass by it.

examples.sentence: 游客进去以后如果只顾着拍照，就不一定真能观赏到花慢慢开出来的样子，所以工作人员总劝大家先走一圈再停下看。
这批鱼不是买来吃的，老板特意放在门口让客人观赏，所以孩子每次经过都要站在玻璃前看半天。
老师带学生去看演出以前先提醒他们，观赏的时候别一直讲话，不然身边的人很难听清台上的细节。

example_translations.translation: After visitors go in, if they only focus on taking pictures, they may not really appreciate the way the flowers slowly open, so the staff always advise people to walk around once before stopping to look.

These fish were not bought to be eaten. The owner purposely put them at the entrance for customers to admire, so every time children pass by, they stand in front of the glass and stare for a long while.

Before taking the students to see the performance, the teacher first reminded them not to keep talking while watching and appreciating it, or the people beside them would have a hard time hearing the details on stage.

glosses.notes: 官员 means a government official, especially when talking about public duty, public statements, or administrative decisions.

examples.sentence: 新闻里那位官员来现场的时候没有先坐下听汇报，而是先去看河边还没修好的那一段旧路到底难走到什么样。
当地官员后来公开道歉，不是因为网上声音太大，而是因为那几户人家等了很久都没有等到最基本的说明。
记者追着问那位官员的时候，对方没有马上回答价格问题，只说官方以后会把安排放出来。

example_translations.translation: When that government official shown in the news arrived at the site, he did not sit down to hear the report first. Instead, he went to see just how hard it was to get through that unfinished stretch of old road by the river.

The local officials later apologized publicly not because the voices online were too loud, but because those several families had waited a long time and still had not received even the most basic explanation.
When the reporter kept pressing that official with questions, he did not immediately answer the pricing issue and only said that the authorities would release the arrangements later on.

glosses.notes: 管道 usually means a pipe or pipeline that carries water, gas, air, or something else from one place to another.

examples.sentence: 修路的人刚把地面挖开，就发现下面那条老管道已经漏了很久，所以周围几家店都只好先等到晚上再用水。
工厂的人说这根管道以前只送冷水，可是后来设备一换，压力变大以后，原来的接口就越来越撑不住了。
老师给孩子看图的时候说，水从高处下来以后，要先走这条细管道，再慢慢流到下面那个大池子里。

example_translations.translation: As soon as the road workers dug open the ground, they discovered that the old pipeline underneath had been leaking for a long time, so several nearby shops had to wait until evening before using water again.
The factory workers said this pipe used to carry only cold water, but after the equipment was changed and the pressure increased, the original joint became less and less able to hold.

The teacher told the child while pointing at the diagram that after the water comes down from the higher place, it first has to go through this thin pipe and only then slowly flow into the large pool below.

glosses.notes: 罐 means a jar, can, or similar container, and it often points to the container itself rather than what is inside.

examples.sentence: 她搬厨房的时候才发现，最上面那个罐里装的不是糖，而是外婆去年自己晒好以后慢慢存下来的茶叶。
孩子看见那罐颜色很亮的糖就想打开，父亲赶紧拦住，说那其实是给客人喝茶时用的糖。
医生提醒她，开过的药别一直放在同一个罐里反复拿，因为只要手上有水，里面的药就容易坏。

example_translations.translation: While moving things around in the kitchen, she discovered that the jar on the top shelf did not contain sugar at all, but tea leaves her grandmother had dried and slowly stored away the year before.
The child saw that brightly colored jar of sugar and wanted to open it, but his father quickly stopped him, saying it was sugar meant for serving tea to guests.
The doctor reminded her not to keep putting opened medicine back into the same jar again and again, because once there is water on your hands, the medicine inside can easily go bad.

glosses.notes: 广阔 describes something as broad or vast, whether it is physical space, vision, prospects, or room for development.

examples.sentence: 车刚开出城，孩子就一直贴着窗看外面那片广阔的田，因为他从来没想到天底下还能一下子看到这么远。
老师说读书的用处有时候不是马上多会做题，而是让一个人以后看问题的时候有更广阔的眼光。
站到山顶以后，大家才明白为什么那么多人愿意一大早爬上来，因为眼前的湖和云一起展开的时候确实很广阔。

example_translations.translation: As soon as the car left the city, the child kept pressing against the window to look at the vast fields outside, because he had never imagined that a person could suddenly see so far at once.
The teacher said that the value of reading is not always that it immediately makes you better at solving problems, but that it gives you a broader way of looking at things later on.

After reaching the top of the mountain, everyone understood why so many people are willing to climb up early in the morning, because when the lake and the clouds spread out together in front of you, the scene truly feels expansive.

glosses.notes: 归 can mean to return, and in more formal use it can also mean to belong to or fall under someone else's control or responsibility.

examples.sentence: 外地工作几年以后，他这次归来没有先去看热闹的地方，而是一下车就先去医院看父亲恢复得怎么样了。
这个项目现在归市场部统一负责，所以别的部门就算临时有意见，也得先把理由写清楚再一起讨论。
比赛拖到最后一轮的时候，谁都不敢先说奖到底归谁，因为前后两个队的分数一直只差一点点。

example_translations.translation: After working away from home for several years, when he returned this time he did not first go to the lively places. Instead, as soon as he got off the vehicle, he went to the hospital to see how his father was recovering.

This project now falls under the unified responsibility of the marketing department, so even if other departments suddenly have opinions, they still need to write their reasons clearly before discussing them together.
By the time the match dragged into the final round, no one dared to say in advance who the prize would go to, because the scores of the two teams had remained only a tiny bit apart.

glosses.notes: 规范 can mean a standard or rule, and it can also mean making something orderly, standardized, and compliant.

examples.sentence: 新来的老师上课前准备得很认真，可是学校还是让她先看两周以前发下来的规范，免得后面写出来的东西和家长最关心的项目不一样。
工厂去年把报修流程重新规范以后，谁什么时候来、哪一步先做，都比以前清楚得多，所以争来争去的情况少了。
医生说这家小医院虽然不大，可是药怎么放、表怎么填都很规范，所以来这里看病的老人反而更放心。

example_translations.translation: The new teacher prepared very carefully before class, but the school still asked her to read the standards sent out two weeks earlier first, so that what she wrote afterward would not come out different from the items parents cared about most.

After the factory standardized the repair-reporting process again last year, it became much clearer who should come when and which step should be done first, so the amount of arguing back and forth dropped.

The doctor said that although this small hospital was not big, the way medicine was placed and forms were filled out was very well regulated, so the older people who came here for treatment actually felt more at ease.
